exposure: Specific features extracted from the fetal heart signal within a 30 min window
Last deceleration occurring closest to delivery
outcome: Neonatal acidemia (umbilical arterial blood pH level below 7.10)
cohort: The study included 502 infants (cases and controls in a 1:1 ratio) born at Miguel Servet University Hospital.
finding: The random forest model achieved the highest area under the receiver characteristic curve (AUC) of 0.971 for predicting acidemia, while the logistic regression model had the best specificity (0.879) for a sensitivity of 0.95.
mod_finding: Implementing a cutoff point of 31% in the logistic regression model could prevent unnecessary cesarean sections in 51% of cases while missing only 5% of acidotic cases.
